name: @alivaon/api-client
description: Client typé de l'API Symfony (types générés depuis openapi.json).

scripts.sync: php ../../../alivaon-symfony/bin/console cache:clear --env=dev -q && php ../../../alivaon-symfony/bin/console api:openapi:export --output="$PWD/openapi.json" && node scripts/normalize-openapi.mjs openapi.json && pnpm run generate
